venue.name: Hard Rock Stadium
venue.source_note: Coordinates and IANA timezone from the public Greerre NFL stadium dataset; current NFL venue names, team assignments and roof classifications checked against the current NFL stadium list. Retractable and partial roofs are conservatively treated as weather-exposed because game-time roof state is not included. Also serves Miami as a current NCAA FBS home venue; school/stadium relationship from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NCAA_Division_I_FBS_football_stadiums.

policy.notes: UNVERIFIED project baseline used only where no venue-specific public procedure was sourced: assume an 8-mile lightning trigger and 30-minute quiet period. This is not an official universal NFL or NCAA rule. NCAA safety guidance is venue-specific and is recorded separately; validate each venue procedure before operational use.
